cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: the defining anionic is Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 (C3 strong ether/sulfonate type), with two prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 amphoteric, Coco-Glucoside @11 nonionic glucoside) and no reinforcing strong anionic. Cocamide MIPA @3 is an alkanolamide foam booster (C3: not a route, not a buffer). Counter-signals (oils @7-8, weak refatters @14/@16, cationic polymers) point milder, never stronger; the convention is unambiguous, so high confidence.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: all four elements are prominent (E3, before Parfum @26): a prominent payload lipid in place of the silicone (Cocos Nucifera Oil @7, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @8), cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-10 @13, Polyquaternium-7 @15, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @18), a pearlizing/fatty route (Glycol Distearate @21) and a deliberate humectant route (Glycerin @5, Panthenol @10). Further light routes (film former Polyimide-1 @12, weak refatters @14/@16) add redundancy; no element is borderline.

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate: three cationic polymers, a film former and two material oils converge, but every deposition ingredient sits after Sodium Chloride @6, polymers at @12-18 in the usual low-dose zone.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate: guar/polyquaternium and film-former deposition is plausibly retained; liquid oils (not waxy) at low dose; no silicone.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate: C1 olefin-sulfonate chassis buffered by betaine and glucoside, an effective ordinary reset.
weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is formally established (material payload lipids @7-8 converging with cationic polymers) and the high-anchor convergence route has three families (cationic_polymer, film_former, material payload_lipid); this is the argument for high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate: several interacting deposition routes (cationic polymers, film former, material oils) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH lacks limited reset (resetCapacity moderate, 6.7 W-RICH limited reset), and the convergence route rests on low-dose ingredients all listed after Sodium Chloride @6 against an effective olefin-sulfonate reset; not low: three cationic polymers plus material oils and a film former (W2) make calling it lightweight an understatement.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Concentrations of the polymers and oils are unknown; a richer actual dose would move it to high (W-RICH and convergence both present).
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (provisional final from formula): converging cationic polymers @13/@15/@18, film former @12 and material oils @7-8 (W-line @22) face a moderate C1 reset; W-RICH holds but reset is not limited, so high is the neighbor, not the band.
